sentences.show: Eight months after they died, a search party found a tent, buried in the snow.
Inside lay Captain Scott, between two of his friends. And his diary.
They were found on this day in 1912, in Antarctica.
In January, Scott's five reached the South Pole. A Norwegian tent was already there.
Roald Amundsen had beaten them by 34 days.
On the way home, Lawrence Oates, crippled by frostbite, walked out into a blizzard.
His last words, Scott wrote: "I am just going outside, and may be some time."
A dog team had waited for them at a supply depot. It turned back when they were only 55 miles away.
Then a blizzard trapped the last three, just 11 miles from food.
Scott's last entry: "For God's sake, look after our people."
The searchers lowered the tent over them, and left it as their tomb.
Also on this day: a probe landed on a comet, and football got its first paid pro.
